In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> a '''skirmish''' was fought between the [[Vagaari Empire]] and the [[New Jedi Order]] aboard the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Dreadnaught-Four]]'' following the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Battle of the Redoubt|escape]] from the inner [[The Redoubt/Legends|Redoubt]] [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]].<ref name="SQ" />
